title: How I Stopped Blowing Through My Claude Limits
description:
Your most powerful AI model is also the most expensive, so using Claude's top models for every small task drains your usage limit fast. Here is the planner-executor-judge loop I use in Claude Code: let Opus 4.8 plan and judge, hand the grunt work to a cheaper model like Sonnet 5 or Haiku 4.5 with a subagent, set a clear goal so it runs until the job is done, then loop or schedule it.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gzE7O-PEdzynAguHTS70vPhbgib-Qb_zirQepAjmun4/edit?usp=sharing
